verified_result: At lbx154/Argus@33da786bbc6787a2eeb63a5f492498eae87c78c7, Manager continuous handoff does not currently provide exact-once backlog-mission plus creation-event semantics across precommit/final-write ambiguity. The before_write callback can persist the mission before final continuous replacement; single-item Backlog.add blindly appends and lacks existing-ID conflict semantics; task_added is independently append-only; fresh Web/TUI retries allocate fresh root_task_id; storage tests prove both callback-committed/final-replace-failed and replace-landed/post-replace-durability-failed ambiguity classes.
scope_guard: Source-level reachability plus existing pinned storage-unit-test evidence only. No live Argus fault injection, no production duplicate observation, no mutation of Argus or exploration state, and no claim that proposed fence/receipt machinery is already implemented or validated.

exact_next_verification.target: minimal exact-insert and immutable creation-receipt primitives for Manager continuous handoff recovery
questions: Do any pinned tests explicitly characterize duplicate IDs through single-item Backlog.add, and can existing add_many([item]) semantics safely provide exact-ID conflict detection for this path without changing unrelated behavior?
Does Argus already have an immutable/idempotent event or operator-message persistence primitive with stable message/event identity that can be reused as the handoff creation receipt?

What exact recovery behavior should be specified for precommit-success/final-replace-fail, post-replace durability ambiguity, repeated recovery with the same reserved mission ID, and task_added append failure after backlog insert?
Can current primitives distinguish already-exists-and-identical from same-ID-different-payload, or is a dedicated add_exact result/receipt required?
required_regression_matrix: precommit mission+event succeeds, continuous replace fails, recovery executes twice with same reserved ID => one physical mission and one creation event
continuous replace lands but post-replace durability fails => readback plus creation receipt finalizes without reinsertion
backlog insert succeeds but task_added append fails => recovery adds only missing event and never a second backlog row
same reserved ID with different mission payload => fail closed as identity conflict
